authority.reason: The current state does not authorize authenticated Wikidot work, sandbox mutation, or authority changes.

action_event_cases.required_authority: A run-owned mailbox fixture and exact message deletion authority.
action_event_cases.cleanup_proof: The created message is absent and no mailbox state outside the run-owned fixture changed.

action_event_cases.required_authority: A run-owned forum fixture with exact thread and post deletion authority.
action_event_cases.cleanup_proof: Every created thread and post is absent and the containing forum state matches its pre-run snapshot.

action_event_cases.required_authority: Run-owned ordinary actors, a pending application, an invitation target, and exact role and application restoration authority.
action_event_cases.cleanup_proof: Applications, invitations, membership, moderator state, and administrator state match the recorded pre-run snapshot.

action_event_cases.required_authority: A run-owned page in a category whose rating mode permits both voting and cancellation without changing site settings.
action_event_cases.cleanup_proof: The run-owned vote and page are absent and the category rating configuration is unchanged.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: Two controlled actors and a run-owned page revision changed after lock acquisition.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: The run-owned page and every acquired lock are absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: Two controlled actors and a run-owned page with non-secret mismatched lock material generated inside the run.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: The run-owned page and every acquired lock are absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: A controlled actor, a run-owned page, and the exact PageEdit cancellation operation.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: A second actor can acquire the released lock and the run-owned page is absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: A controlled actor, a run-owned page, and an observed lock-expiry interval bounded by the run lease.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: A second actor can acquire the expired lock and the run-owned page is absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: One controlled actor and at least two run-owned pages locked within the same session.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: All run-owned pages and locks are absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: Two controlled actors and a run-owned page with a revision conflict created inside the run.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: The accepted revision is identified and the run-owned page and locks are absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: A controlled actor and a run-owned page with a safely reversible, evidenced save rejection.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: The rejected save changed no revision and the run-owned page and lock are absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: A controlled actor and a run-owned page saved without a source or metadata change.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: The revision outcome is read back and the run-owned page and lock are absent.

page_edit_cases.required_authority: Controlled ordinary, denied, and privileged actors whose roles are fixed before the run.
page_edit_cases.cleanup_proof: Every run-owned page and lock is absent and all actor roles match the pre-run snapshot.
